name: R&B Switchgear Group
summary: Manchester-based switchgear and power engineering manufacturer that has hosted Engineering and Manufacturing T Level placement students on mechanical fitting, electrical fitting and CAD work.

name: Sellafield Ltd
summary: Nuclear site operator in West Cumbria that has run T Level industry placements, including a 2027 Maintenance, Installation and Repair placement advertised under the NDA Group.
how_to_apply: Apply through the annual NDA Group (Sellafield Ltd) T Level work placement listing. The 2027 MIR placement was advertised on TargetJobs, with an online assessment then an in-person interview. The 2027 intake closed on 08/10/2026, so watch for the next round.

name: Kane International
summary: Family business making boiler and engine exhaust gas analysers, with a site in Atherton, Greater Manchester, that hosts T Level placement students who have helped set up production line machinery.

name: Lyndhurst Precision Engineering
summary: Chorley precision engineering firm making bespoke components for the energy, automotive and aerospace sectors, which has hosted several T Level placement students.
sites: Chorley works (Top Site, Crosse Hall Street)|PR6 0UH

name: Like Technologies
summary: Lancaster-based engineering firm providing specialist electronic and control system support to nuclear and defence clients, which has hosted T Level placement students.

name: Bentley Motors
summary: Luxury car manufacturer at Pyms Lane, Crewe, hosting T Level Engineering industry placements for Crewe Engineering & Design UTC students across its manufacturing and design departments.
how_to_apply: Via partner college: Crewe Engineering & Design UTC T Level students apply and attend a Bentley-run placement assessment centre.
sites: Pyms Lane headquarters and factory, Crewe|CW1 3PL

name: Leyland Trucks
summary: Truck manufacturer that recruits an annual apprenticeship intake across assembly, automotive engineering, facilities and maintenance, design and control systems roles.
how_to_apply: Annual apprenticeship intake; applications for the 2025 intake opened in January. Check the Apprenticeships and Vacancies sections of the Leyland Trucks website.
